summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of incorrect legend values for large ranges by incorporating the offset value from the `ScalarFormatter`. The change is minimal and focused.

issues.description: The patch does not account for the rcParams settings `mpl.rcParams['axes.formatter.useoffset']` and `mpl.rcParams['axes.formatter.offset_threshold']`, which may affect the behavior of the formatter.
The code could benefit from additional comments explaining the purpose of the offset handling and how it interacts with the formatter settings.
